name: GFWL stub (FusionFix Legacy Addon)
description: Replaces Games for Windows Live with a stub so that 1.0.7.0 starts without GFWL. Brings xlive.dll and XLivelessAddon.asi. The Complete Edition does not need this - only the downgrade reintroduces the GFWL dependency.

sources.note: Legacy Addon by FusionFix. Contains plugins/XLivelessAddon.asi and xlive.dll. If the download fails: https://github.com/ThirteenAG/GTAIV.EFLC.FusionFix/releases, tag v5.0.1 - the same release fusionfix takes its own file from, and only that version matches the checksum above.
